subject: Front-end repricing meets a heavy auction week
telegram_ping: Two-year yields snapped higher into supply; the rate-path theme is doing the work.
html:
Rates

The two-year backed up nine basis points into a heavy auction slate, and the tail on today's reopening says demand at the front end is fragile. The rate-path repricing theme carries this brief.

Lens

Prediction markets moved the same direction but slower: the September-cut contract shed seven points. When the lens lags the tape, the tape usually wins.

Deep research

Term premium models put most of this month's move in the real-rate leg, not inflation compensation. That is a positioning story, not an inflation scare.

subject: Oil's quiet tape hides a positioning story
telegram_ping: WTI barely moved while options skew flipped; someone is paying for upside.
html:
Energy

WTI closed a quiet session almost unchanged, but call skew flipped positive for the first time since April. Flat price plus rising call skew is how positioning stories start.

Rates

Follow-through from yesterday's auction tail: the front end steadied but did not recover. The theme map holds its raise.

subject: Weekend review: what the map got right about the dollar
telegram_ping: The dollar downtrend theme aged well this week; the map holds it at medium conviction.
html:
The week in themes

The dollar downtrend theme was the week's best performer: DXY closed below its June range while rate differentials narrowed on schedule. The map holds conviction at medium pending the CPI print.

Grading

One claim resolved this week and it resolved correct. The scoreboard is thin by design: the system grades only what it committed to in writing.
